thread:
Emily (Product): quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A — can we get a concise timeline for the API / Console / Optimize workstreams? especially batching improvements + the rollout cadence?
Priya (Head of Product): short version: Optimize batching v1 -> beta late May, GA end of June. Console UX for batching controls -> mid-July. API SDK flags -> phased alongside beta.
Emily (Product): thanks — for the rollout, are we sticking to canaries or doing a staged capacity rollout? also how will teams see telemetry for batching effectiveness?
Priya (Head of Product): canaries + staged. plan: 1) internal canary (2 days) 2) external canary (1 week, ~5% traffic) 3) ramp to 25% (1 week) 4) GA. telemetry: new Console dashboard tile (per-route batching efficiency) + event-level traces.
Miguel (Eng Runtime): FYI runtime changes are mostly in continuous batching scheduler + KV cache hooks. perf estimates: 20-40% token cost reduction on conversational workloads after caching. we have a draft rollout config:
```
rollout:
  steps:
    - name: internal-canary
      percent: 0.5
      duration: 2d
    - name: external-canary
      percent: 5
      duration: 7d
    - name: ramp
      percent: 25
      duration: 7d
    - name: ga
      percent: 100
```
Miguel (Eng Runtime): important: Dedicated customers with pinned models will get an opt-in flag for early access; Private installs require an upgraded control plane package.
Ava (Eng ML): Optimize suggestions (quantization + batching) will be surfaced as rule-based recommendations in the Console first; we'll attach a small evaluation harness so customers can preview Q/E tradeoffs before applying.
Sam (SRE): SLO question — will we accept a temporary latency tail increase during canaries? what's the rollback criteria?
Priya (Head of Product): good call. rollback criteria: error rate increase > 2x baseline OR p99 latency worsens by > 30% for more than 10 minutes. we'll publish this in the rollout playbook in Confluence and link in the Console canary view.
Emily (Product): who owns the canary dashboard? I'd like a live link we can reference on the all-hands follow-up email.
Miguel (Eng Runtime): eng-platform will own the dashboard; I'll add a short runbook + Prometheus/Grafana panels.
Priya (Head of Product): action items: @Miguel - add rollout config + dashboard by May 10. @Ava - wire up Optimize preview by May 24. @Sam - validate SLO alerts and rollback hooks by May 10. we'll send a follow-up with the ship calendar.
Emily (Product): perfect. small question — will caching be enabled by default for Hosted customers or opt-in to start?
Miguel (Eng Runtime): default OFF for the first external canary to observe behavior, then ON for 25% ramp if metrics look good. we'll expose an override toggle per-route in the Console.
Priya (Head of Product): note for Dedicated/Private: we'll provide a migration guide and a CLI flag for ops teams.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: batching-scheduler-v1 -> canary cluster at 2023-05-03T03:00:00Z :rocket:
Emily (Product): thanks everyone — I'll draft the follow-up email with the timeline and the runbook links. Please add any docs to the shared folder by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
Miguel (Eng Runtime): adding drafts today.
Ava (Eng ML): will attach the example eval prompts too.
Sam (SRE): I'll create the alert playbook and run a dry-run of the rollback path in staging.
Emily (Product): awesome. closing the thread once the links are in.
